newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador rejects Iberia flight bid.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador rejects Iberia flight bid.

text.p: A Salvadoran congressional committee rejected on Wednesday a request from Spanish airline Iberia to operate a route between Miami and this Central American nation, congressmen said.
Mauricio Retana, chairman of the Public Works Commission, told reporters the refusal was made due to the lack of recipocral accords with Spain and the Salvadoran airline TACA.
The committee will recommemd the rejection to the full congress, Retana said.
Iberia had sought to re-launch passenger, cargo and mail services between Florida and El Salvador.

Iberia operated flights to El Salvador up to 1980 when the company decided to suspend the routes because of the civil war. It restarted flights in 1994 under a temporary accord renewable every six months. The last Iberia flight allowed to land was in December 1995.
